preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**5 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each test case has a length n of strings A and B between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == len(B) == n for n, A, B in [(int(stdin.readline()), stdin.readline().strip(), stdin.readline().strip())])
preconditions.description: For each test case, strings A and B have the same length n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrst' for c in A) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrst' for c in B)
preconditions.description: Both strings A and B consist only of the first 20 lowercase English letters (a to t).

postconditions.expression: all(output == -1 or (output >= 0 and output <= n) for output in [int(line) for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either -1 (impossible) or a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of moves (0 to n).

postconditions.expression: all((A == B) or (output == -1) for A, B, output in [(stdin.readline().strip(), stdin.readline().strip(), int(stdout.readline()))])
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, it is possible to transform A into B using the specified moves. If the output is -1, no such transformation exists.

postconditions.expression: all((output == -1) or (all(A[i] == B[i] or (A[i] != B[i] and any(A[j] == A[i] for j in range(n))) for i in range(n))) for A, B, n, output in [(stdin.readline().strip(), stdin.readline().strip(), int(stdin.readline()), int(stdout.readline()))])
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, for every position i where A[i] != B[i], there exists at least one other position j where A[j] == A[i] (i.e., the character at position i in A can be changed via a move).

postconditions.expression: all((output == -1) or (all(A[i] == B[i] or (A[i] != B[i] and B[i] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrst') for i in range(n))) for A, B, n, output in [(stdin.readline().strip(), stdin.readline().strip(), int(stdin.readline()), int(stdout.readline()))])
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, for every position i where A[i] != B[i], the target character B[i] is one of the first 20 lowercase letters (a to t).

postconditions.expression: all((output == -1) or (output == min_moves) for A, B, n, output in [(stdin.readline().strip(), stdin.readline().strip(), int(stdin.readline()), int(stdout.readline()))])
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, it is the smallest number of moves required to transform A into B. The minimum moves are determined by grouping positions where A[i] != B[i] and A[i] is the same across those positions, then assigning each group to a move.
